name: AppShell
description: Frames the application with header, sidebar, main and optional aside regions, sharing sidebar state.
propsSummary: collapsed / defaultCollapsed / onCollapsedChange: the desktop rail
open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange: the mobile panel

layout.description: `default`: the header spans the top. `sidebar`: the rail runs the full height and the header sits beside it.

onCollapsedChange.description: Called when the rail collapses or expands

onOpenChange.description: Called when the mobile panel opens or closes

collapsible.description: How the rail collapses: to its glyphs, off the canvas, or never

when: Layouts needing header, sidebar and main together
Navigation that must become a modal panel on small screens
whenNot: Content-first sites with no app navigation
guidelines: Put a Main inside AppShell.Main: Main owns the 16 gutter and the <main> landmark; the slot adds neither
AppShell is the Sidebar.Provider: set sidebar state here, not on AppShell.Sidebar
Columns follow the slots' own token widths, so collapsing is instant and an absent slot takes no room
Every region is canvas, the aside included; hairlines separate them
Header.Trigger shows on small screens and when the rail is off the canvas
The aside drops under main below lg
accessibility: AppShell.Header is the banner landmark; a Header inside it renders a div
Below md the sidebar is a modal dialog with a focus trap, Escape and a scrim

examples.name: Dashboard
examples.description: Full-height rail with the brand and grouped sections, a header with search and actions, a page of metrics.
examples.code:
import { ChartBar as OverviewIcon, Gear as SettingsIcon, GitPullRequest as PullRequestIcon, ListChecks as FindingsIcon, Palette as TokensIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react";
import { AppShell } from '@/components/AppShell';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { Button } from '@/components/Button';
import { Card } from '@/components/Card';
import { Grid } from '@/components/Grid';
import { Header } from '@/components/Header';
import { Input } from '@/components/Input';
import { Main } from '@/components/Main';
import { Sidebar } from '@/components/Sidebar';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

const metrics = [
  { value: '94%', label: 'Component coverage' },
  { value: '3', label: 'Open findings' },
];

<AppShell layout="sidebar">
  <AppShell.Header>
    <Header>
      <Header.SkipLink />
      <Header.Trigger />
      <Header.Search expandable>
        <Input placeholder="Search…" aria-label="Search" />
      </Header.Search>
      <Header.Actions>
        <Button>New check</Button>
        <Avatar name="Alice Johnson" size="sm" />
      </Header.Actions>
    </Header>
  </AppShell.Header>
  <AppShell.Sidebar>
    <Sidebar.Header>Fragments</Sidebar.Header>
    <Sidebar.Nav>
      <Sidebar.Section label="Workspace">
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<OverviewIcon />} href="/overview" active>Overview</Sidebar.Item>
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<FindingsIcon />} href="/findings" badge="3">Findings</Sidebar.Item>
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<PullRequestIcon />} href="/pull-requests">Pull requests</Sidebar.Item>
      </Sidebar.Section>
      <Sidebar.Section label="Design system">
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<TokensIcon />} href="/tokens">Tokens</Sidebar.Item>
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<SettingsIcon />} href="/settings">Settings</Sidebar.Item>
      </Sidebar.Section>
    </Sidebar.Nav>
    <Sidebar.Footer>
      <Sidebar.CollapseToggle />
    </Sidebar.Footer>
  </AppShell.Sidebar>
  <AppShell.Main>
    <Main>
      <Main.Header>
        <Main.Title>Overview</Main.Title>
        <Main.Description>Three repositories, checked on every pull request.</Main.Description>
      </Main.Header>
      <Main.Content>
        <Grid columns={2} gap="md">
          {metrics.map((metric) => (
            <Card key={metric.label}>
              <Card.Body>
                <Text as="p" type="display" tabularNums>{metric.value}</Text>
                <Text as="p" color="secondary">{metric.label}</Text>
              </Card.Body>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Main.Content>
    </Main>
  </AppShell.Main>
</AppShell>

examples.name: Offcanvas Rail
examples.description: Collapsing takes the rail off the canvas for reading; Header.Trigger brings it back.
examples.code:
import { BookOpen as GuideIcon, FileText as ReferenceIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react";
import { AppShell } from '@/components/AppShell';
import { Header } from '@/components/Header';
import { Main } from '@/components/Main';
import { Sidebar } from '@/components/Sidebar';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<AppShell collapsible="offcanvas" defaultCollapsed>
  <AppShell.Header>
    <Header>
      <Header.SkipLink />
      <Header.Trigger />
      <Header.Brand href="/">Fragments</Header.Brand>
    </Header>
  </AppShell.Header>
  <AppShell.Sidebar>
    <Sidebar.Nav>
      <Sidebar.Section label="Guides">
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<GuideIcon />} href="/guides/components" active>Choosing components</Sidebar.Item>
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<GuideIcon />} href="/guides/tokens">Adopting tokens</Sidebar.Item>
      </Sidebar.Section>
      <Sidebar.Section label="Reference">
        <Sidebar.Item icon={<ReferenceIcon />} href="/reference/rules">Rules</Sidebar.Item>
      </Sidebar.Section>
    </Sidebar.Nav>
  </AppShell.Sidebar>
  <AppShell.Main>
    <Main measure="narrow">
      <Main.Header>
        <Main.Title>Choosing components</Main.Title>
        <Main.Description>The rail stays off the canvas while you read; the menu button brings it back.</Main.Description>
      </Main.Header>
      <Main.Content>
        <Text as="p">Start from the components your product already has. Build a new one only when nothing fits, so every screen keeps one look and one behaviour.</Text>
      </Main.Content>
    </Main>
  </AppShell.Main>
</AppShell>

relations.note: AppShell sits inside the Theme provider
Sidebar content goes inside AppShell.Sidebar; AppShell is its provider
Main goes inside AppShell.Main and owns the gutter and the <main> landmark
